tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Neutral grey behind the icon rail and section column, framing the raised content inset.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Ink: primary text and titles (17.7:1 on card, 16.1:1 on background).

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The content inset from 768px up: a near-white surface raised off the grey by shadow-panel, with the header as its top. Panels on it stay white with their own shadow.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, inputs and the current item in the rail. White on the grey ground, lifted by shadow-panel rather than an outline.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one filled action per task area.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary action: lightens, since primary is already near black. Never fades.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on primary (17.7:1) and on primary-hover (10.4:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Soft fill inside a white panel: neutral pills and quiet blocks.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Badges, segmented controls and quiet controls.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary buttons and surfaces.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Supporting copy and metadata on card (7.7:1), canvas (7.4:1), background (7.0:1) and secondary (6.6:1).

tokens.name: quiet
tokens.usage: Badge text, table headings and section labels, on secondary and background (8.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover fill on menu items in the rail and column, secondary buttons and the sidebar toggle.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline between rows inside a panel, and the edge of outline buttons and toggles (with shadow-tab). Panels themselves have no outline.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Edge of inputs, selects and text areas: 3.7:1 on card and 3.3:1 on background, so an empty field is findable without its label. Buttons use the lighter border.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid cobalt with a 2px offset (7.4:1 on card, 6.8:1 on background).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one signal colour, cobalt: focus, the reached level on a rail, and selected controls. Never decoration.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and error emphasis, coral (5.5:1 on card, 5.0:1 on background).

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The icon rail and section column: one grey surface split by a sidebar-border hairline; alias of background.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Module icons and section names (9.5:1 on sidebar).

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: The current module and section: white with shadow-tab and medium weight.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text of the current module and section.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Expanded detail inside a table row, and the info notice.

tokens.name: table-head
tokens.usage: Column headings of a table inside a panel.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on table and list rows inside a panel, and an open row; lighter than tint so the row and its detail block stay apart.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Unlit segments of level and coverage rails.

tokens.name: rail-lit
tokens.usage: The reached level on a rail, in cobalt. The words beside the rail always say it too.

tokens.name: rail-soft
tokens.usage: Estimates and met requirements on a rail, light cobalt. 2.5:1 on card, so the count in words carries the meaning.

tokens.name: status-solid
tokens.usage: Text for solid, proven or passing, teal on status-solid-surface (4.8:1) and on card (5.5:1). Teal keeps it apart from coral by more than hue.

tokens.name: status-solid-surface
tokens.usage: Fill behind status-solid text.

tokens.name: status-partial
tokens.usage: Text for partly there, in progress or close, on status-partial-surface (5.0:1).

tokens.name: status-partial-surface
tokens.usage: Fill behind status-partial text.

tokens.name: status-gap
tokens.usage: Text for gaps, misconceptions or failures, coral on status-gap-surface (4.9:1).

tokens.name: status-gap-surface
tokens.usage: Fill behind status-gap text.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card; alias of foreground.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Toasts, menus and the search dialog; alias of card.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover; alias of foreground.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent; alias of foreground.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Filled action inside the rail; alias of primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on sidebar-primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: The hairline between the icon rail and the section column; alias of border.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus inside the rail; alias of ring.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Page title at 1280px and up; 34px from 768px, 30px on a phone. Tracking -0.035em.

styles.name: section-title-lg
styles.usage: Title of the one dominant panel on a page.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Panel titles and row titles inside panels, 15 to 17px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Select text on any page and press E

styles.name: fact-value
styles.usage: A fact value under its label in a page heading; 13px on a phone.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Metadata, counts and fact labels, in muted-foreground.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small uppercase label above a page title, 0.08em tracking. Only when it adds context.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Badge and pill text. Never colour alone.

styles.name: rail-label
styles.usage: Labels under a rail; 10px on a phone.

tokens.name: space-rail-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between rail segments.

tokens.name: space-menu-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between menu items in the icon rail and section column (shadcn gap-1).

tokens.name: space-inset
tokens.usage: Gap between the content inset and the window edge, and the padding around menus in the rail and column (shadcn m-2 and p-2).

tokens.name: space-page-mobile
tokens.usage: Main padding on a phone.

tokens.name: space-panel-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling panels.

tokens.name: space-row-x
tokens.usage: Side padding of rows and the panel title inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-page-desktop
tokens.usage: Main padding on desktop and standard panel padding.

tokens.name: space-panel-lg
tokens.usage: Padding of the one dominant panel.

tokens.name: space-heading-bottom
tokens.usage: Space under a page heading on desktop (20px on a phone).

tokens.name: size-menu-item
tokens.usage: Menu buttons in the icon rail and section column, section tabs and the brand square (shadcn h-8).

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and small buttons.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Icon rail width: shadcn's 3rem icon sidebar plus the 1px hairline.

tokens.name: size-header
tokens.usage: Height of the content inset's header, with a hairline under it, and of the section column's title row.

tokens.name: size-section-column
tokens.usage: Section column width (shadcn's 16rem sidebar minus the 3rem rail). Hidden under 1024px, or with Ctrl or Cmd + B, when sections move to tabs.

tokens.name: size-mobile-menu
tokens.usage: Width of the phone menu that slides in from the left (shadcn's 18rem).

tokens.name: radius-item
tokens.usage: Items inside menus and the command list, and small inline focus outlines (shadcn rounded-sm).

tokens.name: radius-menu
tokens.usage: Menu buttons in the rail and column, section tabs, the sidebar toggle, notices and blocks inside a panel (shadcn rounded-md).

tokens.name: radius-tab
tokens.usage: Inputs, the brand square and the owner's initials.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, the content inset, toasts and the search dialog.

tokens.name: radius-segment
tokens.usage: Rail and coverage segments.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, pills and the search field.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Every panel and the content inset: a faint edge and a soft lift, instead of an outline.

tokens.name: shadow-tab
tokens.usage: The current menu item in the rail and column, and the current section tab.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Toasts and other floating layers only.

meta.note: This design system is the source of truth for Ken OS's look. The app keeps a word-for-word copy of this file and turns it into CSS variables; look changes start here, never in a code PR.
